app.name: TG Proxy
settings.title: Settings
tip.h2:
Share one HTTP/2 connection per data center and domain for media downloads through Cloudflare.
Requires CF proxy and TLS enabled.
label.dc_hint: One rule per line, format: number:IP
label.no_secure: Disable TLS for CF-proxy and CF-worker
label.autostart_hint: If you move the app to another folder, the autostart entry may reset.
tip.host:
Address the proxy listens on.
Usually 127.0.0.1 for localhost, 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces
tip.port: Proxy port. Telegram Desktop proxy settings must use the same port
tip.dc:
Mapping of Telegram data center (DC) number to web.telegram.org dc server IP.
Each line: «number:IP», e.g. 4:149.154.167.220. The proxy routes traffic to Telegram servers using these rules

If connection fails then fallbacks are used
tip.verbose: When enabled, more details are written to the log file — useful for troubleshooting
tip.no_secure: When enabled, the proxy will use port 80 for CF-proxy and CF-worker connections
tip.buf_kb:
Receive/send buffer size in kilobytes.
A larger value allocates more memory per socket
tip.pool:
How many ready WebSocket connections to keep per data center.
0 disables the direct DC->IP WebSocket route
tip.log_mb: Maximum log file size; the file is overwritten when the limit is reached
tip.autostart: Launch TG Proxy on Windows login. If you move the app to another folder, autostart will reset
tip.check_updates: Check on startup and hourly: GitHub first, then the update server.
tip.cfproxy: Use Cloudflare proxy for unreachable data centers
tip.cfproxy_domain:
Your own domains proxied through Cloudflare for HTTP/2 and WS connections.
Separate multiple domains with commas.
If empty — chosen automatically from supported domains
tip.cfproxy_user_domain_cb: Specify your own domains instead of automatic selection
tip.cfworker_domain:
Cloudflare Worker domains (e.g. name.account.workers.dev).
Separate multiple domains with commas.
The proxy routes connections to Telegram DCs by IP through them

diagnostics.port_busy:
Failed to start proxy:
Port is already in use by another application.

Close the app using this port, or change the port in proxy settings and restart.
diagnostics.permission:
Failed to start proxy:
Access to address/port denied (firewall, antivirus, or permissions).

Change the port to a random value in 10000–50000 in settings, check firewall/antivirus, and restart.
diagnostics.bad_address:
Failed to start proxy:
Invalid or unavailable listen address.

Check the solution at the link opened in your browser.
Verify host and port in proxy settings and restart.
ipv6.warning:
IPv6 connectivity is enabled on your computer.

Telegram may try to connect over IPv6, which is not supported and may cause errors.

If the proxy does not work or logs show IPv6 connection attempts, try disabling IPv6 connection attempts in Telegram proxy settings. If that does not help, try disabling IPv6 system-wide.

This warning is shown only once.

connection_diagnostics.title: Connection check
connection_diagnostics.hint: Checks route availability. No Telegram messages or files are sent; download speed is not measured.
connection_diagnostics.idle: Run a check when you need it. Your settings stay unchanged.
connection_diagnostics.cancelling: Cancelling the check and closing test connections…
connection_diagnostics.cancelled: Check cancelled. Completed probe results are shown below.
connection_diagnostics.stale: Proxy settings or state changed. This result is out of date; run another check.
connection_diagnostics.failed: The check could not finish. Try again; your settings were not changed.
connection_diagnostics.issues: No available transport was confirmed. Individual connection errors are shown below.
connection_diagnostics.available_with_er: Some transports are available; other connections failed. Check operation in Telegram.
connection_diagnostics.local_unavailable: A connection to the local proxy was not confirmed. Remote probes do not confirm Telegram connectivity through this app.
connection_diagnostics.scope: Enabled CF/Worker groups: first {limit} addresses each. HTTP/2, fallback TCP and legacy Helper are not confirmed by this check.
connection_diagnostics.available: Tested transports are available. Check message delivery and file transfers in Telegram.
connection_diagnostics.partial: No working route was confirmed. Some connection types can only be verified while Telegram is in use.
connection_diagnostics.advice.start_prox: The proxy is stopped. Start it and run the check again.
connection_diagnostics.advice.open_route: Review route and Helper settings. The check does not change addresses, tokens or TLS protection.
connection_diagnostics.advice.open_teleg: Open Telegram and try sending a message and downloading a file. Transport availability alone cannot confirm these operations.
connection_diagnostics.advice.retry: Run the check again. If the problem persists, copy the support report; it does not include credentials.
connection_diagnostics.error.tls: TLS verification failed; security was not disabled
connection_diagnostics.error.helper_reje: Helper did not grant access; review the token and route
connection_diagnostics.error.h2_unconfir: requires an actual media request; availability is unconfirmed
connection_diagnostics.error.tcp_unconfi: requires an actual MTProto request; availability is unconfirmed
connection_diagnostics.partial_available: Some transports are available. Other routes were not fully verified; check operation in Telegram.
